name: Honda N-BOX JF1 (1st gen 2011–2017, S07A 658cc kei, CVT, FWD)
source: Honda Japan maintenance schedule for N-BOX (JF1), converted from km. JDM import: parts by chassis code JF1.

items.name: Engine oil
items.notes: 0W-20 (NA) / 0W-20 or 5W-30 (turbo). Honda Japan: NA every 15,000 km (9k mi) / 1 year; turbo every 5,000 km (3k mi) / 6 months. If it's the turbo, do an oil change between services too.

items.name: Oil filter
items.notes: Honda: every second oil change. With your 5k rule, just do it every service.

items.name: Service inspection (brakes, tyres, suspension, CV boots, leaks, lights)
Spark plugs (iridium)
items.notes: Honda: 100,000 km. Turbo engines often need them sooner.

items.name: CVT fluid (Honda HMMF)
items.notes: JF1/JF2 use Honda Ultra HMMF (not HCF-2, which is for the JF3/JF4). Drain ~2.5–3 L from the 18 mm drain plug, refill the same amount, and check hot on the dipstick (between the HOT marks). Honda lists 'inspect'; changing every ~40,000 km protects the CVT, and a replacement CVT for an import is hard to find.

items.name: Coolant (Honda Type 2)
items.notes: First change at 11 years / 200,000 km, then every 6 years / 100,000 km.

items.name: 12V battery (idle-stop type, e.g. M-42)
items.notes: Idle-stop batteries wear out fast. Get the correct type.

items.name: Auxiliary drive belt (inspect)
items.notes: The S07A has a timing chain, not a belt.
